name: Stemmies
summary: Stemmies is a biological simulation set in Titan City, a 2.5D bio-punk metropolis. You enroll at a medical academy, track pathogen vectors across the city, and use a seamless infinite zoom to dive from the skyline down to the cellular level, where you manage hemodynamics, pilot a nano-sub through blood vessels, and build chemical synthesis pipelines to engineer a cure. An AI-driven chief medical officer and a squad of digital interns run your pathology labs while you trade bio-assets on a live exchange fueled by ATP.
